title: Inflict Pain
author: Dark Sun Engine
description: A new telepathic devotion for psionicists: Inflict Pain plants raw agony in a foe's mind. Unless its psionic defence holds, the creature is -4 to hit and can't cast spells this round and the next, and for as long after as the psionicist keeps it up (2 PSPs a round). 2 PSPs, a Constitution check at -4. It uses Ego Whip's icon and look. Off: the game has only the original's powers.
